reason: Losing two big customers hurts, but my business runs on people knowing me and picking up the phone. I don't see a stranger's cold emails from new domains doing that, and six weeks of profiles, positioning and CRM sounds like the strategy deck I don't need.
objection: They promise no meetings, and in wholesale a meeting isn't an order anyway. I'd pay 3,500 plus 1,800 a month and maybe end up with calls from people who just want a price list, while my name goes out to people who don't know me.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to another distributor my size here who got real repeat orders from it, not just meetings, or paying mainly when a meeting turns into a customer.
